changes.P01: Both launches use the same sandbox and all requested WebRTC switches. Fallback explicitly selects full Chromium instead of the default headless shell; unavailable isolated launches abort before ready.
changes.P02: Capture installation ownership before workflow side effects; unconditional finally disposes runtime and snapshots even when cleanup-entry persistence fails. Ambiguous finalization quarantines admission in memory and best-effort storage.
changes.P03: Separately owned, shielded cleanup survives repeated job cancellation and has its own cleanup deadline. Independent snapshot teardown is attempted after runtime failure; unconfirmed teardown cannot publish proof or release quarantine.
changes.P05: Track non-assignment bindings as unproven handler types and reject exception-suppressing finally returns/breaks/continues. Preserve trusted aliases, diagnostic reraises, nested function returns, and control transfers local to finally loops.
